title: Closing Share by Cashback Payment Record and Shopper Level — Cartwise Shopper Payouts Desk Guidance
content:
### Desk guidance: the closing share of a card-plan cashback settlement

**Rule.** For a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account on an Everyday Pay Card plan, the share at which the capped statement month is settled onto the card at closing depends on the payment record and level: an account with 3 or more cashback payments in the last 3 months whose shopper is at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level is settled in full (a share of 1.0); an account with 3 or more cashback payments in the last 3 months whose shopper is below Full-Service Shopper Platinum level is settled at 0.75. For any other account no raised share applies.

The closing share multiplies the capped statement month; no rounding takes place at this point.

**Definitions.**

- *Cashback payments* are the cashback payment entries booked on the payout account (payments of statement-month cashback onto the card).
- *The last 3 months* counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the closing.
- *Shopper level* is the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order.

**Condition table.**

| Cashback payments in the last 3 months | Shopper level | Closing share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 1.0 (in full) |
| 3 or more | Shop-Only Shopper up to Full-Service Shopper Gold | 0.75 |
| 2 or fewer | any level | no raised share |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**

- Exactly 3 cashback payments in the last 3 months, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum: settled in full.
- Exactly 3 payments, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold (below Platinum): settled at 0.75.
- 2 payments, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Diamond: the payment count is under 3, so no raised share applies.
- A payment booked exactly 3 whole months before the day of the closing is not in the window; one booked a day later is.
